name: MEDIQA-QA
intro: MEDIQA-QA 是 MEDIQA 2019 Task 3：系统需判断 CHiQA 为消费者健康问题检索出的候选答案是否正确，并对正确答案排序。训练集来自 LiveQA 与 Alexa；竞赛测试输入隐藏排序、评分和标签，官方仓库现另行公开赛后带标签副本。
org: U.S. National Library of Medicine, IBM Research
build_method: LiveQA与Alexa训练问题及留出消费者健康问题, CHiQA候选答案检索, 医学专家四级评分与重排, 3/4分映射为正确标签而1/2分映射为错误标签
metric: Accuracy（主分）、Spearman rho（次分）、MRR 与 Precision（meta；四项独立，无综合分）
task_type: 候选答案二分类, 正确答案重排
eval_feature: 提交 QuestionID,AnswerID,Label 三列；README称标签0会被过滤，但评测器仍将每一行计入MRR名次；RQE/MedQuAD与NLI仅为可选策略
build_method_en: LiveQA and Alexa training questions plus held-out consumer-health questions, CHiQA candidate retrieval, medical-expert four-level rating and reranking, then mapping scores 3/4 to correct and 1/2 to incorrect
eval_feature_en: Submit QuestionID,AnswerID,Label rows; the README says label-0 rows are filtered, but the evaluator still counts every row toward MRR rank; RQE over MedQuAD and NLI are optional strategies only
intro_en: MEDIQA-QA is MEDIQA 2019 Task 3: systems classify whether CHiQA-retrieved candidate answers correctly answer consumer-health questions and rank the correct answers. Training questions come from LiveQA and Alexa; the competition test input hid ranks, scores, and labels, while the official repository now separately publishes a post-challenge labeled copy.

drawio_review_note: Evidence baseline: MEDIQA 2019 shared-task paper ACL Anthology W19-5039, Sections 2.3, 3.3, 4.1, and 5.3, plus official repository commit cefa5a1b89e8263aeea0dbe59da52990963cdd1d (2019-09-04). Task 3 data and evaluator are unchanged at repository head 32311a139b583a9ccec133b3f8a21873d4ff3561 (2026-05-13). Exact split counts are LiveQA 104 questions/839 answers, Alexa 104/862, validation 25/234, and test 150/1,107. Experts assign scores 4 Excellent, 3 correct but incomplete, 2 related, and 1 incorrect plus ReferenceRank 1-11; scores 3/4 map to label 1 and 1/2 to label 0. The 2019 competition TestSet.xml contains QID, question, AID, AnswerURL, and answer text but no SystemRank, ReferenceRank, or ReferenceScore attributes (SHA-256 342b4860892eedcd0494365e897b4e76e8ea5377eee5e8703f2202da5a40fc18); the current post-challenge TestSet-wLabels.xml adds all three attributes and contains 572 positive plus 535 negative labels (SHA-256 df9bca894d252279f200ee78e85d871b57a94b224d75467b7fa38a4a0952cc1d). The repository declares CC BY 4.0, but has no LICENSE file and does not enumerate rights or crawl dates for third-party AnswerURL sources. Neither paper nor repository reports Task 3 annotator count, double labeling, inter-annotator agreement, adjudication, CHiQA retrieval parameters/date, or deduplication. Submission rows are QuestionID,AnswerID,Label. The README says label-0 rows are filtered and its example places positive rows first, but the evaluator increments the rank index for every submitted row before testing label==1; a preceding label-0 row or false positive therefore lowers MRR. The evaluator parses headerless CSV, drops duplicate QID+AID pairs keeping the first, computes exact-triple Accuracy, pooled positive Precision, macro MRR, and matched-positive Spearman independently, and averages Spearman only across questions whose coefficient is not NaN. It returns Accuracy as score, Spearman as score_secondary, and MRR plus Precision as meta with no composite score. Public reproduction requires a narrow repair because the released test ground truth has a header although the evaluator uses header=None, and the script demo paths are absent. RQE over MedQuAD and NLI are optional, not required pipeline stages. The official AIcrowd challenge page retains a completed leaderboard. Fresh strict desktop exports from the final English and Chinese specs were both 1,825 by 1,173 pixels and were visually reviewed on 2026-07-21 with no clipping, overlap, connector-node crossing, or illegible full-resolution text.
